name: Treacherous Torrent
description:
Fast Action: Equip this to your Hydro Hypostasis.
After your Hydro Hypostasis or Water Droplet deals DMG, heal the most damaged Monster on your side for 1 HP. (3 times per Round)
(You must have Hydro Hypostasis in your deck to add this card to your deck.)
